name: Toy Con UK
blurb: The UK's only dedicated designer toy convention, held annually in London with exhibitor tables of independent toy and art-toy makers.
notes: Homepage (extract.mjs, home mode) still presents the 2026 edition as current: 'We look forward to seeing you on May 2nd and 3rd, 2026 at the Novotel London West! TOYCON UK 2026 TICKETS ON SALE FEBRUARY 15TH AT 12:00PM' and 'ALL TOYCON UK 2026 EXHIBITOR SPACES ARE SOLD OUT!'. That edition already ended before today (2026-10-05) and the site has not been updated with 2027 dates, so editions is empty and the May 2026 run is recorded as 'last'. Toy Con UK is an exhibitor/dealer-table designer-toy fair with no separate celebrity guest program (nav has Exhibitors but no Guests page), so guests would be 'none' once an edition exists. Cover uses hero:0, the '2026 TC POSTER' key art (1130x1401, filename contains POSTER); the og image is a generic Squarespace social placeholder. Organizer name not found on the pages checked.
